Question: asalamualykum, i have asked another question before but still havent recieved an ansewr. this is another question, dear respected ulema what does islam speak about smoking marijuana, and does it affect your pray for how long. because i have heard that for 40 days ur namaz wont be counted if u drink alcohol but wt bout marijuana. jazakallh! Answer ID: 14216 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1109/1109=M/1430) Marijuana ( ganja ) is an intoxicant item and Shariah disallows every intoxicant: کل مسکر حرام It is forbidden to even go nearer to Salah in the state of intoxication, as the Quran says: لا تقربوا الصلاۃ وانتم سکاری What you have heard about alcohol is right. This Hadith is mentioned in Tirmizi, Nasai etc. There is no narration particularly about marijuana. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
